avoid: Heavy jewelry that may cause injury during fast movement
children.game_version: A 'follow the leader' game where children mimic different animals or plants using the dance's mudras.

seniors.seated_version: Focus on the mimetic hand gestures (mudras) and upper body swaying to the rhythm of the flute.
seniors.standing_version: Gentle rhythmic stepping in place without the acceleration of tempo.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Maintain a slow, steady tempo; avoid the traditional increase in speed.

social_formats.description: Group dance involving both male and female participants, often moving between villages.

movement_profile.formation_and_space: Group formation, often moving from village to village
movement_profile.tempo_feel: Accelerando; starts slow and increases in speed

music_profile.sound_description: The sound is dominated by the deep, rhythmic pulse of the khamb drum and the melodic overlays of the bamboo flute. The music is designed to build energy, starting at a steady pace and accelerating to a climax that mirrors the excitement of the harvest.

basic_steps: Gather in a mixed group of boys and girls
Follow the rhythmic beat of the khamb (drum)
Maintain a tempo that gradually increases throughout the performance
Incorporate gestures that mimic the natural environment or agricultural actions
teaching.level_notes: The dance is a communal folk form accessible to the youth of the community.
teaching.rhythm: Rhythmic and percussive, driven by drums and flutes
